title: Incident reporting assistance and automated availability need an exercised user path
remediation: The deployment incident support owner publishes the approved assistance route to users and reviews automated information delivery and access. Exercise a benign request from an allowed user, verify timely assistance and assigned escalation, and retain sanitized evidence that support guidance and intake were reachable under normal and degraded conditions.
